summary: Deterministic email-verified WhatsApp connection and canonical chat registration; source and hosted activation tracked separately.
noAssistantImpact: No new model tool or merchant command is introduced. Connection/registration remain deterministic authentication controls. Planned, app-review and source-only Setup/Product workflow availability is preserved.
